claim_verdicts.evidence: Execution, outputs/stage-3/scripts/devops/gitops-revert.txt:1-4: after the bad commit 'staging: Synced, Progressing' while '1 sha-000... false ErrImagePull'. app_wait (gitops.sh:112-127) reads .status.sync.status = Synced at the bad commit: sync status did not flag the missing image. No Argo CD doc sentence says the comparison skips the registry; execution settles it.

refs deployment.md: maxUnavailable 'The absolute number is calculated from percentage by rounding down. ... The default value is 25%.' maxSurge 'The absolute number is calculated from the percentage by rounding up. The default value is 25%.' envs/staging/api.yaml: 'replicas: 2', no strategy. 2x25% -> unavailable 0, surge 1. Output: '2 1.0.0 true' + '1 sha-000... false ErrImagePull'.

Round 2: s4 now reads 'the Application shows `Progressing`, not `Healthy`' (round-1 suggested_text applied). refs images.md: 'ImagePullBackOff means that a container could not start because Kubernetes could not pull a container image ... The BackOff part indicates that Kubernetes will keep trying'. ErrImagePull is not in refs; execution settles it: output line 4 'false ErrImagePull', script line 30 greps for both reasons. Argo CD 3.1 health: Progressing = not healthy yet but still making progress.

refs deployment.md 'Rolling Back to a Previous Revision': 'kubectl rollout undo deployment/nginx-deployment' -> 'deployment.apps/nginx-deployment rolled back'. The command talks to the API server only; the config repo clone is untouched until script line 48. Output 8-9: 'deployment.apps/api rolled back', 'right after: the Deployment names 1.0.0'.

Argo CD 3.1 auto_sync: 'If the selfHeal flag is set to true, then the sync will be attempted again after self-heal timeout (5 seconds by default)'; 'An automated sync will only be performed if the application is OutOfSync.' apps/staging.yaml: 'automated: selfHeal: true'. Script:40 loops seq 120 / sleep 1. Output 9-10: 'right after: ... 1.0.0' then 'shortly after: ... sha-000...'.

Argo CD 3.1 sync-options, Selective Sync: 'Currently, when syncing using auto sync Argo CD applies every object in the application.' The Deployment is OutOfSync after the undo, so any sync applies Git's tag to it.
Argo CD 3.1 auto_sync, as fetched: 'Rollback cannot be performed against an application with automated sync enabled.'

git-revert: 'Given one or more existing commits, revert the changes that the related patches introduce, and record some new commits that record them.' --no-edit: 'With this option, git revert will not start the commit message editor.' The page does not quote the subject format; execution does: output line 15 'gitops-revert.sh: Revert "Deploy api sha-000... to staging"', line 16 keeps the bad commit.
Execution: script:53-54 'app_wait_sync <revert>' then 'app_wait Synced Healthy <revert>' printed 'staging: Synced, Healthy' (output 13); line 56 api_images printed only '2 1.0.0 true' (output 14).

refs EF Core history-table.md: 'EF Core keeps track of which migrations have been applied to the database by recording them in a table named __EFMigrationsHistory.' migrate-hook.yaml: hook 'created by every sync, in wave 1'; nothing in it reverses a migration. git-revert only records commits that revert file changes. Conclusion follows.

Round 2: claim now adds the fix-forward clause ('When it does not, the way forward is a new deploy commit naming an image that does', s4). Still conditional on the older api not working with the newer schema, rests on claims 9 and 10; no ranking or unconditional advice.

git-push PUSH RULES: 'only fast-forward updates are allowed, which means the destination must be an ancestor of the source commit.' --force: 'It can cause the remote repository to lose commits'. Teammate main = good<-bad<-new; server main after reset = good, an ancestor, so a plain push is a fast-forward and restores bad. Round 2 s6 wording ('even if that drops commits'; 'the server's branch holds nothing theirs lacks') matches. apps/staging.yaml 'targetRevision: main'.
Opinion with its condition ('When Argo CD manages a Deployment'); factual basis is claims 5, 7, 12.
